comparison.objective: Lay out a cup, pouch, and spoon case at specified diner-relative clock positions and radius; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Meal layout tests viewpoint reasoning and accurate multi-object placement. Candidate tests recessed tool insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment, tightening, and dynamic feedback use.
comparison.success_condition: Three objects must reach specified clock positions 10 cm from the plate center; candidate requires two safe impact stops with no drift or failure.
comparison.reason: Precise layout and damper commissioning test different abilities despite both requiring accuracy.
